Healthy.solution: No disease detected. Continue standard monitoring and fertilization schedule.

Leaf Blight.solution: Apply fungicide containing copper oxychloride or mancozeb (2g/L). Improve air circulation, avoid overhead watering, and remove infected leaves immediately.

Rust (Puccinia).solution: Spray propiconazole (0.1%) or sulfur dust. Remove infected leaves. Avoid nitrogen-heavy fertilizers. Apply every 10-14 days during wet season.

Powdery Mildew.solution: Apply potassium bicarbonate solution or horticultural oil (neem oil 3ml/L). Ensure full sun exposure. Use resistant varieties in future seasons.

Bacterial Leaf Spot.solution: Apply copper-based bactericide (Bordeaux mixture 1%). Remove and destroy infected plant parts. Avoid working in fields when wet. Improve drainage.

Leaf Curl Virus.solution: No chemical cure for viral infection. Remove and burn infected plants. Control whitefly vectors with imidacloprid (0.5ml/L). Use virus-free seeds next season.
